relationship: Requesting a URL connects its protocol, domain and path to DNS resolution, retrieval and page rendering.

learnerLoop.action: Enter or choose a URL and send the request.
learnerLoop.modelChange: The request progresses through resolve, retrieve and render phases.
learnerLoop.evidence: Phase markers, progress, operation text and browser view show the current work.
learnerLoop.nextDecision: Inspect which URL part or network service is needed next.

invariants: The displayed phases remain ordered from resolution through retrieval to rendering.
URL parts shown in the model derive from the requested address.
safeAdaptations: Change URLs, site stories or pacing while retaining the DNS-to-rendering sequence.
nonGoals: Acting as a real browser or querying live DNS.

task.description: Resolve a name, retrieve a page, then repair the missing directory mapping.
task.visibility: Present throughout; content follows the current simulation state.

browser.description: URL navigation, destination-IP/request/HTML state and rendered page.
browser.visibility: Present throughout; content follows the current simulation state.

infrastructure.description: Local DNS cache, editable directory, query/reply paths and web servers.
infrastructure.visibility: Present throughout; content follows the current simulation state.

evidence.description: Current navigation outcome and transfer beside the browser internals.
evidence.visibility: Present throughout; content follows the current simulation state.

address.description: Domain/path translated to a server IPv4 address.
address.domain: Three fictional sites with fixed addresses.
address.source: URL/bookmark, DNS cache and editable directory.
address.output: Destination IP, transfer labels and requested server.

transfer.description: Navigation phase and queued transfer position.
transfer.domain: Resolve, retrieve and render; cached lookups skip remote-directory transfers.
transfer.source: Queue built from URL and cache state.

modes.navigation: Atlas initially requires remote lookup and is cached; Orbit starts cached; Field Notes lacks a mapping.
modes.repair: Field Notes becomes retrievable when its directory maps to 203.0.113.77 and a fresh navigation starts.
modes.support: No Working or exam controls. Go/Next advances one transfer; Render is the final action.

dependencies: DNS must return an address before any page request.
The server must match the address and requested path before returning HTML.
Changing a directory entry alone does not restart an already failed navigation.
implementation.completion: Done appears only after the HTML is rendered; missing mapping, invalid URL, missing server or file produce distinct failures.
limitations: Local simulation of three sites; no real DNS or web fetch.
Rendered site miniatures preserve their distinct page styling and purposeful viewport.
